mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.employee_no AS employeeNo, e.name AS employeeName, e.birth_date AS birthDate, e.dept_id AS deptId, e.position_id AS positionId, e.employee_status AS status, e.user_id AS userId, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.position_name AS positionName FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1
